title: like a rag doll (Remix)
lyrics:
didn't play well 
im under your spell

hittin me around the court
like a rag doll

give it another fling

hittin me around the court
like a rag doll

watch me fight

hittin....me around the court
like a rag doll.

you are the dog and
i am the hog

tap it
poke it
drive it
stoke it


hittin....me around the court
like a rag doll.

de doby doooo beeeee doooo
Thats you!
